# Medical Assembler
The [color=#5b97bc]Medical Assembler[/color] synthesizes auto-injectors and other medical consumables from raw reagents. Insert beakers or syringes containing the required reagents, then press [bold]ASSEMBLE[/bold].
## How to Use
Most recipes require an [color=#a4885c]empty medipen[/color] — the blank shell the assembler fills during synthesis.
- Fill a beaker or syringe with the required reagents at the [color=#5b97bc]Chemistry Dispenser[/color]. - Place an [color=#a4885c]empty medipen[/color] into the assembler along with the reagent containers. - Insert the filled container(s) into the Medical Assembler. - Press [bold]ASSEMBLE[/bold]. The machine will consume the reagents and eject the finished product. - Use [bold]EJECT ALL[/bold] to retrieve unused containers.
## Recipes
### Burn Auto-Injector Treats burn damage.
- [color=cyan]Dermaline[/color] — 10u - [color=cyan]Leporazine[/color] — 10u - [color=#a4885c]Empty Medipen[/color] — ×1
### Lacerinol Auto-Injector Treats slash wounds and lacerations.
- [color=cyan]Lacerinol[/color] — 10u - [color=cyan]Tranexamic Acid[/color] — 5u - [color=#a4885c]Empty Medipen[/color] — ×1
### Bruizine Auto-Injector Treats blunt trauma and bruising.
- [color=cyan]Bruizine[/color] — 10u - [color=cyan]Tranexamic Acid[/color] — 5u - [color=#a4885c]Empty Medipen[/color] — ×1
### Poison Auto-Injector Treats toxin poisoning.
- [color=cyan]Ultravasculine[/color] — 10u - [color=cyan]Epinephrine[/color] — 5u - [color=#a4885c]Empty Medipen[/color] — ×1
